import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 256;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static class Edge {
        int u, v, flow, cap, next;
        Edge() {}
        Edge(int u, int v, int flow, int cap, int next) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        int n, s, t;
        int[] head = new int[MAXN];
        int[] current = new int[MAXN];
        int[] dist = new int[MAXN];

        void init(int n, int s, int t) {
            this.n = n;
            this.s = s;
            this.t = t;
            edges.clear();
            Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
            edges.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, cap, head[u]));
            head[u] = edges.size() - 1;
            edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, head[v]));
            head[v] = edges.size() - 1;
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            dist[s] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).next) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(i);
                    if (e.flow < e.cap && dist[e.v] == -1) {
                        dist[e.v] = dist[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.v);
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[t] != -1;
        }

        int sendFlow(int u, int flow) {
            if (u == t)
                return flow;
            for (int i = current[u]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).next) {
                Edge e = edges.get(i);
                if (e.flow < e.cap && dist[e.v] == dist[u] + 1) {
                    int curr_flow = Math.min(flow, e.cap - e.flow);
                    int temp_flow = sendFlow(e.v, curr_flow);
                    if (temp_flow > 0) {
                        e.flow += temp_flow;
                        edges.get(i ^ 1).flow -= temp_flow;
                        return temp_flow;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxFlow() {
            int total = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                    current[i] = head[i];
                int flow;
                while ((flow = sendFlow(s, INF)) > 0)
                    total += flow;
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static int n, t, zx, zy;
    static char[][] smp = new char[12][12], cmp = new char[12][12], work = new char[12][12];
    static int[][] vis = new int[12][12];
    static int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int X(int i, int j) {
        return i * n + j;
    }

    static int Y(int i, int j) {
        return n * n + i * n + j;
    }

    static int S() {
        return n * n * 2;
    }

    static int T() {
        return S() + 1;
    }

    static int N() {
        return T() + 1;
    }

    static class Point {
        int x, y, t, type;
        Point(int x, int y, int t, int type) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.t = t;
            this.type = type;
        }
    }

    static void bfs(int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<Point> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new Point(sx, sy, 0, 0));
        vis[sx][sy] = 1;
        q.offer(new Point(zx, zy, 0, 1));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Point u = q.poll();
            int nx, ny;
            if (u.t == t)
                break;
            if (u.type == 0 && Character.isLetter(work[u.x][u.y]))
                continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                nx = u.x + dx[i];
                ny = u.y + dy[i];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n) {
                    if (u.type == 0 && vis[nx][ny] == 0 && !Character.isLetter(work[nx][ny])) {
                        vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                        q.offer(new Point(nx, ny, u.t + 1, 0));
                    } else if (u.type == 1 && !Character.isLetter(work[nx][ny])) {
                        work[nx][ny] = 'Z';
                        q.offer(new Point(nx, ny, u.t + 1, 1));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String line;
        while ((line = br.readLine()) != null && !line.trim().isEmpty()) {
            String[] parts = line.trim().split("\\s+");
            if (parts.length < 2) continue;
            n = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
            t = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
            Dinic dinic = new Dinic();
            dinic.init(N(), S(), T());

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                line = br.readLine();
                System.arraycopy(line.toCharArray(), 0, smp[i], 0, n);
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (Character.isDigit(smp[i][j]) && smp[i][j] > '0') {
                        dinic.addEdge(S(), X(i, j), smp[i][j] - '0');
                    } else if (smp[i][j] == 'Z') {
                        zx = i;
                        zy = j;
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                line = br.readLine();
                System.arraycopy(line.toCharArray(), 0, cmp[i], 0, n);
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (Character.isDigit(cmp[i][j]) && cmp[i][j] > '0') {
                        dinic.addEdge(Y(i, j), T(), cmp[i][j] - '0');
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (!Character.isDigit(smp[i][j]) || smp[i][j] <= '0') continue;
                    for (int xi = 0; xi < n; ++xi) {
                        for (int yi = 0; yi < n; ++yi) {
                            if (!Character.isDigit(cmp[xi][yi]) || cmp[xi][yi] <= '0') continue;
                            Arrays.fill(vis, 0);
                            for (int x = 0; x < 12; ++x)
                                Arrays.fill(work[x], (char)0);
                            System.arraycopy(smp, 0, work, 0, n);
                            bfs(i, j);
                            if (vis[xi][yi] != 0) {
                                dinic.addEdge(X(i, j), Y(xi, yi), INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            System.out.println(dinic.maxFlow());
        }
    }
}
